regime_context: China A-shares themes are led by AI Compute & Optics, with Semiconductors close behind in a narrowing rotation; only 6 of 22 themes are eligible. The absolute-trend gate did not historically reduce drawdown here (gate_helps=false), and rank-IC is near zero, so directional leans are experimental and low-conviction. Unscheduled macro surprises dominate (share 0.56), adding fragility.
emerging_watch: Semiconductors (challenger) may mount a leadership handoff; watch for margin closing to <0.1 and Semiconductors overtaking in score. Kill if spread widens to >0.5 and stabilizes.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The leader is trending (hurst=trend), durable (0.55), uncrowded, and eligible. While the gate has no local edge, the only multi-sector validated discipline is trend-following for drawdown control; we apply it experimentally. Coincident macro AI/tech narrative provides context but not a buy trigger.
theses.dissent: With gate_helps=false, trend-following offers no historical downside protection here; the lead could quickly mean-revert if the AI narrative fades or geopolitics spikes. High unscheduled-surprise share makes abrupt reversals likely.

falsifier.text: Score drops below 1.0 or falls out of eligibility, or Semiconductors overtakes with a margin >0.3 for 5 consecutive days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
